metas.name: Soulm8te
metas.description: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to reprogram her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem. Available on Hulu in 4K.

metas.name: Alien Storm
metas.description: A businessman's grand Las Vegas party is halted by a mysterious fog, driving him and his guests into his secret bunker as a sinister presence threatens them. Available on Prime Video in 1080p.

metas.name: undertone
metas.description: The host of a popular paranormal podcast becomes haunted by terrifying recordings mysteriously sent her way. Available on HBO Max in 1080p.

metas.name: Dinosaur Hunt
metas.description: A rich family are brought together to a remote island for a reunion, only to learn that their father has been experimenting with dinosaurs in an attempt to find a cure for his disease. This family are forced to work together when the dinosaurs escape. Available on Prime Video in 1080p.

metas.name: The Distant Jump
metas.description: Jennifer's daughter is abducted by a criminal organization that plans to harvest her supernatural abilities in order to jump into a distant, alternate reality. Available on Prime Video in 1080p.

metas.name: In the Blink of an Eye
metas.description: Three storylines, spanning thousands of years, intersect and reflect on hope, connection, and the circle of life. Available on Hulu in 4K.

metas.name: 28 Years Later: The Bone Temple
metas.description: Dr. Kelson finds himself in a shocking new relationship - with consequences that could change the world as they know it - and Spike's encounter with Jimmy Crystal becomes a nightmare he can't escape. Available on Netflix in 4K.

metas.name: Greenland 2: Migration
metas.description: The surviving Garrity family must leave the safety of the Greenland bunker and embark on a perilous journey across the decimated frozen wasteland of Europe to find a new home. Available on HBO Max in 1080p.

metas.name: Housemaid
metas.description: After his wife's consciousness is transferred into their android maid, a widower finds himself trapped in a deadly love triangle when the jealous A.I. goes to terrifying lengths to prevent him from moving on with a new woman. Available on Prime Video in 1080p.
